excerpt: nEXO is a next-generation neutrinoless double beta decay experiment planned for SNOLAB, a deep mine two kilometers underground, using 5,000 kg of the xenon-136 (136Xe) isotope enriched to 90%. A consortium of over 150 scientists and technologists from 31 institutions and eight countries are contributing to the design and construction of nEXO.
publisher: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / nEXO Collaboration
title: nEXO Overview
